evidence: Retrieved seasonal table: May–September prime season; November–March short, cold, often wet and described as the cheapest and emptiest period. Coastal links including Kennemer sit on free-draining sand, extending the season. Lower-rate/quieter claims are regional editorial guidance, not a verified Kennemer discount or guaranteed tee-time availability.

evidence: Station Wisley 1991–2020 table: May mean daily max/min 18.17/7.51°C, sunshine 196.98h; June 21.12/10.39°C, sunshine 200.04h, rain 47.06 mm on 8.03 days ≥1 mm. Surrey regional proxy, not observations on Wentworth or Walton Heath.

title: Walton Heath Golf Club — Old Course and visitors
evidence: Official overview: Old Course designed by Herbert Fowler, open Surrey heathland; phased winter restoration. Visitor welcome is distinct from guaranteed access or course conditions.

evidence: Visitors welcome Monday–Friday from 9.30am, weekends and Bank Holidays from midday (11am in winter). The published winter table says 36 holes are not available due to light; 36-hole play in the main season is where available. No fee amounts copied into public notes.

title: Golf at Wentworth — members and guests
evidence: Official page: members and their guests may play all three courses; East and West originally designed by Harry Colt in the early 1920s. This does not establish open public visitor tee-time booking. No evidence here places the modern BMW PGA Championship in May; that unsupported note is removed.

title: Visitors Notes of Guidance
publisher: Muirfield / The Honourable Company of Edinburgh Golfers (official)
evidence: Visitor playing days Tuesdays and Thursdays, recognised handicap 24 or less. May–September peak months: bookings not taken for threeballs, two-balls or singles; smaller groups join a cancellation waiting list. Private-club access is conditional, not general public availability.

title: Crans-Montana — by train from international gateways
evidence: Official access page: rail links from Geneva/airport to Sierre/Siders; onward bus/taxi or Sierre–Crans-Montana funicular. Geneva is a gateway to the Alpine resort, not the location of the Ballesteros course.

title: Climate of Singapore — seasons and temperature
evidence: Official climate page: October–November inter-monsoon has light, variable winds and afternoon/evening thunderstorms, sometimes severe. Higher rainfall November–January. December and January joint coolest months by 24-hour mean (26.8°C; Changi 1991–2020). Small temperature differences do not imply cool or dry golf.

title: Afstanden winter greens — winter-green positions
evidence: Club publishes winter-green placements for its A, B and C loops. This establishes the existence of winter alternatives, not a guaranteed opening schedule; visitors must check current conditions.
